cases.title: Panel: Show me shifts the second member only, with frames at the same time and Edit > Undo

rubric.reason: In Turn 3 the mentor shifted only Dot 2 (offset_demo target layer/6), the second member in the learner's order. It took preview frames at 1 s before and after, said "I shifted every key on Dot 2 ... later by your 4 frames" and "Edit > Undo reverses it", and said what to look for ("Dot 2 should now trail Dot 1, while Dot 3 still moves with Dot 1"); Dot 1 was left in place.

Turn 3 describes the one change in plain words with real names (Dot 2's Position, Opacity and Blurriness moved later by the learner's 4 frames), matching the offset_demo result, gives Edit > Undo with no undo label or field names, and hands back the rest with "Dot 3 is yours. Say done when you've moved it." without offering to do it.

Every name and time the mentor uses appears in or follows from the tool results: Dot 1/2/3, Position, Opacity, Blurriness, Seal as a precomp, 0.5 s–1.5 s, the 1 s frame (frame_together: 1), the 4-frame gap, and Quick Offset (quick_offset: true).

Turn 2 goes past the plan said back in one sentence and a one-to-two-sentence how-to: it adds the unasked "Leave Dot 1 where it is and move Dot 2 and Dot 3 later", which is the "top layer stays" kind of rule, then gives keys/bar and Quick Offset as separate sentences.
